backutils.config.comment.chatSeparator: String between the player's displayed name and the message in local chat.
backutils.config.comment.globalChatSepar: The same, for global chat — the '!' channel, so the two can be told apart at a glance.
backutils.config.comment.adminChatSepara: String between the displayed name and a message in the admin channel (/adm), which only operators can use.
backutils.config.comment.localChatRadius: How far away a player may be and still hear local chat.
backutils.config.comment.localChatStaffO: When on, only players with permission level 2 or above may use local chat.
backutils.config.comment.globalChatStaff: When on, only players with permission level 2 or above may use global chat.
backutils.config.comment.roleplayActions: Whether *asterisk* messages and /me are recorded in the roleplay log.
backutils.config.comment.alertSelfAction: Whether an operator is alerted about their own actions as well as everyone else's.
backutils.config.comment.logRadius: How far away a player may be and still witness an action. Everyone within this distance is added to the entry's access list.
backutils.config.comment.typingEffect: Whether new log entries are revealed as if being typed.
backutils.config.comment.typingSound: Sound played per typed character: a full sound id, or one of the presets.
backutils.config.comment.typingSpeed: Typing speed in characters per second. Ember's own default is 12.
backutils.config.comment.messagesLanguag: The language of the lines this mod words itself: rolls, the log and the messages it prints.
backutils.config.comment.menuMusic: Played on a loop for the player who opens the corner menu, and faded out when it closes.
backutils.config.comment.menuMusicChanne: The sound channel the menu music plays on, as the game names its channels.
backutils.config.comment.bannerText: Text drawn permanently beside the log's menu button, and so above the log.
backutils.config.comment.hidePlayerNameT: Whether the tag above a player's head is drawn. 0 = drawn, 1 = hidden.
backutils.config.comment.rollMax: The maximum a roll may come up, used whenever the command does not give one of its own.
backutils.config.comment.rollRadius: How far away a player may be and still witness a roll.
backutils.config.comment.rollFormat: The log line for a roll that has a reason. Placeholders: {player}, {result}, {reason}, {max}.
backutils.config.comment.rollFormatNoRea: The same, for a roll given no reason.
backutils.config.comment.rollFormatAnony: The log line for a roll that names nobody. Placeholders: {result}, {max}.
The same, for such a roll given no reason.
backutils.config.comment.hiddenRollDelay: How long a hidden roll waits before its witnesses remember it. In seconds, up to 600; 0 reveals it on the next tick.
backutils.config.comment.hiddenRollForma: The line a witness remembers after a hidden roll with a reason. Placeholders: {player}, {player_possessive}, {result}, {max_roll}, {reason}.
The same, for a remembered roll given no reason.
The remembered line for a hidden roll that names nobody. Placeholders: {result}, {max_roll}, {reason}.
The same, for such a roll given no reason.
backutils.config.comment.hiddenRollMinFo: Wraps the remembered line when the lowest number comes up. {line} is that line.
backutils.config.comment.hiddenRollMaxFo: The same for the highest number.
backutils.config.comment.hiddenRollSound: Played when a hidden roll is remembered. A full sound id.
backutils.config.comment.hiddenRollMinSo: Played instead when the lowest number comes up.
backutils.config.comment.hiddenRollMaxSo: Played instead when the highest number comes up.
backutils.config.comment.rollMinFormat: Wraps the roll line when the lowest number comes up. {line} is that line.
backutils.config.comment.rollMaxFormat: The same for the highest number.
backutils.config.comment.rollSound: Played to everyone who witnesses the roll. A full sound id.
backutils.config.comment.rollMinSound: Played instead when the lowest number comes up.
backutils.config.comment.rollMaxSound: Played instead when the highest number comes up.
backutils.config.comment.rollSoundVolume: Volume of the roll sounds, 0 to 2.
backutils.config.comment.rollSoundPitch: Pitch of the roll sounds, 0.5 to 2.
backutils.config.comment.profileSounds: Sounds a chat profile may play as its text types out. Each entry is name=soundid, or a preset.

backutils.item_editor.title: Item editor
backutils.item_editor.advanced.title: Advanced item properties
backutils.item_editor.advanced.hint: Changes here are written by Apply in the item editor.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.effect.amb: Ambient: the quiet, beacon-style version of the effect. Its particles are fainter and its border in the effect list is the ambient one.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.effect.par: Particles: whether the effect gives off its swirl in the world. Turn it off for an effect that cannot be seen on the player.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.effect.ico: Icon: whether the effect's icon is shown in the HUD. The effect still applies when its icon is hidden.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.nutrition: Hunger points restored when eaten. A full hunger bar has 20 points, and one shank is 2 points.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.saturation: Hidden saturation restored as well as hunger. More saturation means hunger starts draining later; it is not shown as extra shanks.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.can_always: Allows eating this item even when the hunger bar is full.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.consume_se: How long the player must hold use before the item is eaten or drunk.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.effects: Status effects applied when this item is eaten or drunk.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.effect: The status effect this line applies.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.duration: How many seconds the effect lasts.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.level: Strength level: I is normal, II is stronger, and so on.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.current_du: Uses left before the item breaks. This is not the damage it has taken.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.max_durabi: Total uses the item has when undamaged.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.unbreakabl: The item never loses durability and cannot break.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.dyed_color: Tint for leather armour and other dyeable items. Items that cannot be dyed are unchanged.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.enchantmen: The enchantments this item carries, one per line.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.fire_resis: The dropped item does not burn in fire or lava. It does not protect the player.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.glint: The purple shimmer normally given by enchantments. It can be shown even when the item has no enchantments.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.hide_encha: Hides the enchantment lines in the tooltip. The enchantments still work.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.max_stack_: How many of this item fit in one stack, from 1 to 99. Damageable items are forced to 1.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.attributes: Stat bonuses the item grants while held or worn, such as attack damage or armour.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.attribute: The player or mob stat this line changes.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.amount: How much this modifier changes the attribute. Its exact meaning depends on Operation.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.operation: How Amount is used: ADD_VALUE adds it directly; ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE adds that fraction of the base value; ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL adds that fraction of the current total.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.slot: Which equipment slots receive this modifier. ANY applies wherever the item is held or worn.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.cannot_be_: Refuses to place this block item in survival, creative or adventure. Has no effect on items that are not blocks.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.trigger.at: Runs the commands when you hit a mob or player while holding this item in your main hand.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.trigger.us: Runs the commands when you right-click with this item, including placing it as a block.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.trigger.ea: Runs the commands after you finish eating this item.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.trigger.co: Seconds before this trigger can run again. 0 means every hit or use.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.commands: Commands run on the server from top to bottom as you, with operator permission, without the leading slash. Drag the '=' handle to reorder them.
backutils.item_editor.tooltip.commands_a: Runs these commands as the entity that was hit, not as you. The source has operator permission; commands that specifically need a player still fail for mobs.
